insights.prompt_summary: Please generate a complete summary of this meeting
insights.scene_idle_title: 15 min idle · Need a meeting summary?
insights.scene_idle_body_pre: You haven't interacted for a while. This session has
insights.scene_idle_body_post: topic(s). I can generate a complete meeting summary with key decisions and action items.
insights.scene_context_summary: The technology selection being discussed was similarly evaluated in last quarter's infrastructure review, where the conclusion was to prioritize containerized deployment.
insights.scene_context_solution: Suggest reviewing the previous review's decision record and building new discussion on top of existing conclusions to avoid re-exploring resolved issues.
insights.scene_consensus_title: Team has reached implicit consensus on core direction
insights.scene_consensus_summary: While the discussion appears to debate Option A vs Option B, all participants agree on 'user experience first' and 'cost controllable' principles — the divergence is only in implementation paths.
insights.scene_consensus_solution: Suggest confirming the two shared principles as the decision foundation, then focusing on a cost comparison of the implementation paths.
insights.cat_context_desc_what: Brings in relevant background beyond the current discussion — historical decisions, cross-knowledge-base connections, industry trends — to help participants see the bigger picture.
insights.cat_context_desc_trigger: Auto-scanned every 60 seconds during recording; can also be manually triggered via 'Analyze Now'. Subject to cooldown and session limits.
insights.cat_context_desc_how: Collects the last 20 transcript lines and chapter titles, then LLM analyzes and surfaces relevant context participants may not be aware of.
insights.cat_blindspot_desc_what: Identifies overlooked factors in the discussion — unconsidered stakeholders, unverified assumptions, long-term consequences of short-term decisions.
insights.cat_blindspot_desc_trigger: Auto-scanned every 60 seconds during recording; can also be manually triggered via 'Analyze Now'. Subject to cooldown and session limits.
insights.cat_blindspot_desc_how: Collects the last 20 transcript lines and chapter titles, then LLM examines the discussion for potentially missed critical factors.
insights.cat_consensus_desc_what: Distills genuine consensus points from scattered discussion, locates the root causes of divergence, and helps the team reach meaningful agreement.
insights.cat_consensus_desc_trigger: Auto-scanned every 60 seconds during recording; can also be manually triggered via 'Analyze Now'. Subject to cooldown and session limits.
insights.cat_consensus_desc_how: Collects the last 20 transcript lines and chapter titles, then LLM analyzes all viewpoints to extract consensus and divergence roots.
insights.manual_check_ok_body: Based on deep analysis of current discussion compared with agenda topics, no additional context or blind spots found.
insights.manual_check_need_transcript: Not enough transcript data yet (need at least 5 lines). Please wait for more speech and try again.
insights.manual_check_need_chapters: No chapter titles generated yet. Please wait for the agenda structure to be established.
